assigned_subskill: mixed Bangla-consonant and English-letter ordinal coding
question_bn: যদি চ × G = ৪২ হয় তবে J × ট = ?
solution_steps: Infer an ordinal code from the example: চ is sixth in the Bangla consonant sequence, and G is seventh in the English alphabet, giving 6 × 7 = 42.
Using the same interpretation, J has English-alphabet position 10.
ট has Bangla-consonant position 11, after ক, খ, গ, ঘ, ঙ, চ, ছ, জ, ঝ, ঞ.
Multiply 10 × 11 = 110, matching ১১০. The coding rule is inferred, not explicitly stated in the PDF.
